journey.name: contacts load cancellation
journey.description: Precondition: an onboarded disposable iOS wallet with Paykit enabled, an authenticated Pubky profile, at least one saved contact, and the public key of another published profile not yet saved as a contact. The device is in English. This checks iOS SwiftUI task cancellation; Android has no corresponding SwiftUI lifecycle. Delaying SDK reads or cancelling before a view task starts requires fault injection and is covered by the regression tests.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (id "DrawerContacts")
Tap Add (id "ContactsAddButton"), enter the unsaved public key (id "AddContactPubkyField"), and tap Add (id "AddContactAdd")
Wait for the contact preview and tap Save (id "AddContactSave")
Verify the Contact Saved screen shows the saved contact (id "ContactViewName") and no "Failed to load contacts" cancellation toast appears during the next five seconds
Tap Back (id "NavigationBack") and verify the saved contact is present in Contacts (id "Contact_<pubky>")
Immediately tap a saved contact's row to leave Contacts, and verify the contact detail screen shows that contact without a "Failed to load contacts" cancellation toast during the next five seconds
